Summarise policy measures by fiscal event

Source: R/policy_measures.R
policy_measures_summary.Rd

Aggregates the measures returned by get_policy_measures() to give the net Exchequer effect (positive = revenue-raising / spending-reducing for tax, spending-increasing for spending) by fiscal event and fiscal year.

Usage

policy_measures_summary(x)

Arguments

x

An obr_tbl returned by get_policy_measures().

Value

An obr_tbl with columns:

type

"tax" or "spending"

event

Fiscal event

fiscal_year

Fiscal year

value_mn

Sum of the Exchequer effect across all measures scored at that event, in GBP million

Provenance is preserved.

See also

Other policy measures: get_policy_measures()

Examples

# \donttest{
op <- options(obr.cache_dir = tempdir())
pm <- get_policy_measures(type = "tax", since = "2024-25")
